== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Danz Borin (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]]. Compared with [[Danz Borin (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]]. The whole 2019 disc card image and the whole 2023 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>72690359961ab4e5c782310316b3b06ce1efdcdd</code>.
